# Luke Popler

> IB Diploma Candidate, ASB Director of Technology, Cross Country/Track captain, and 3D printing club founder at Sequoia High School.

Personal site covering Luke's work, activities, and projects.

## Pages

- [Home](https://lukepopler.me/): Mathnasium tutoring, 3D Printing and Modeling club, Cross Country & Track, development tools, RunScore, RecovHR, other software projects, and music.
- [RecovHR](https://lukepopler.me/recovhr): A heart-rate-reserve algorithm for individualized interval recovery.
- [RunScore](https://lukepopler.me/runscore): A composite index scoring U.S. counties on the strength of their running culture.
- [Multivariable Calculus](https://lukepopler.me/multi): Class page with syllabus and classwork.
- [IB History](https://lukepopler.me/IBhistory): Class page with the Internal Assessment.
